conceptBreakdown.heading: 8.1 10 High-Yield NEST Misconceptions & Traps
conceptBreakdown.title: 8.1 10 High-Yield NEST Misconceptions & Traps

summaryBox.title: NEST Exam Traps
summaryBox.takeaway: Total nodes = n-1; 3d_z² has 0 planar nodes (2 conical nodes); 4s electrons are lost FIRST in transition metal ionization.

conceptBreakdown.content:
1. **Total Nodes in Atomic Orbitals**: Total nodes $= \mathbf{n - 1}$, composed of $(n - l - 1)$ radial nodes and $l$ angular nodes.
2. **3d_z² Nodal Surfaces**: $3d_{z^2}$ has **ZERO planar nodal surfaces** and **two conical nodal surfaces** at $\theta = 54.74^\circ$.
3. **Photoelectric Frequency vs Intensity**: Emission occurs ONLY if $\nu \ge \nu_0$. Light intensity governs photocurrent rate, NOT electron kinetic energy.
4. **Bohr Model Applicability**: Bohr's model applies strictly to single-electron species ($\text{H}, \text{He}^+, \text{Li}^{2+}, \text{Be}^{3+}$).
5. **Ionization Order in Transition Metals**: $4s$ electrons lie at higher spatial radius and are **LOST FIRST during ionization** ($3d^n 4s^2 \rightarrow 3d^n$).
6. **Heisenberg Uncertainty in Daily Life**: HUP applies universally, but $\Delta x \cdot \Delta v$ is negligible for macroscopic masses ($m \gg m_e$).
7. **Wavefunction $\psi$ vs $\psi^2$**: $\psi$ is wave amplitude (can be positive/negative); probability density is represented by $\psi^2$ (always $\ge 0$).
8. **Bohr Radius Significance**: $a_0$ ($0.529\text{ \AA}$) is the **MOST PROBABLE distance** for $1s$, where $4\pi r^2 R^2$ peaks.
9. **Orbital Angular Momentum**: Depends strictly on azimuthal quantum number $l$: $L = \sqrt{l(l+1)}\hbar$, completely independent of $n$.
10. **Palladium Ground State**: Palladium undergoes a double $s\rightarrow d$ shift: $[\text{Kr}] 4d^{10} 5s^0$ with zero $5s$ valence electrons.

conceptBreakdown.heading: 8.2 Master Chemistry Glossary (48 Terms)
conceptBreakdown.title: 8.2 Master Chemistry Glossary (48 Terms)
conceptBreakdown.content:
• **Absorption Spectrum**: Dark lines produced when continuous radiation passes through a cooler gas.
• **Angular Node**: Planar or conical surface where angular wavefunction $Y(\theta,\phi) = 0$. Count $= l$.
• **Anode Rays**: Streams of positive ions whose $e/m$ depends on discharge tube gas.
• **Aufbau Principle**: Rule stating subshells fill in order of increasing $(n+l)$ energy values.
• **Azimuthal Quantum Number ($l$)**: Determines subshell geometry and orbital angular momentum ($L = \sqrt{l(l+1)}\hbar$).
• **Balmer Series**: Transitions to $n_1 = 2$, falling in the visible spectrum ($400\text{--}700\text{ nm}$).
• **Bohr Radius ($a_0$)**: First orbit radius of Hydrogen atom ($a_0 = 0.529177\text{ \AA}$).
• **Cathode Rays**: Streams of electrons with constant $e/m = 1.7588 \times 10^{11}\text{ C/kg}$.
• **Compton Effect**: Increase in photon wavelength when scattered by stationary electrons.
• **de Broglie Wavelength**: Matter wave wavelength $\lambda = h/p = h/mv$.
• **Degenerate Orbitals**: Orbitals of the same subshell having equal energy in absence of magnetic fields.
• **Exchange Energy ($E_{\text{ex}}$)**: Stabilizing energy from parallel electron swaps: $E_{\text{ex}} = \frac{n(n-1)}{2} K$.
• **Heisenberg Uncertainty Principle**: Fundamental limit $\Delta x \cdot \Delta p \ge \hbar/2$.
• **Hund's Multiplicity Rule**: Degenerate orbitals singly occupied with parallel spins before pairing.
• **Isodiaphers**: Nuclides with identical neutron excess ($N - Z = A - 2Z$).
• **Isoelectronic**: Species possessing identical total numbers of electrons.
• **Isosteres**: Species with same number of atoms AND same total electrons.
• **Isotones**: Nuclides with identical neutron numbers ($N = A - Z$).
• **Lyman Series**: Transitions to $n_1 = 1$, located in the Ultraviolet spectrum.
• **Pauli Exclusion Principle**: No two electrons can have identical four quantum numbers.
• **Photoelectric Effect**: Ejection of electrons when light of frequency $\nu \ge \nu_0$ strikes a metal.
• **Radial Node**: Spherical shell where radial wavefunction $R(r) = 0$. Count $= n - l - 1$.
• **Rydberg Constant ($R_H$)**: Spectroscopic constant $R_H = 109677\text{ cm}^{-1} = 1.09677 \times 10^7\text{ m}^{-1}$.
• **Schrödinger Equation**: Fundamental quantum wave differential equation $\hat{H}\psi = E\psi$.
• **Work Function ($\Phi$)**: Minimum energy to liberate an electron into vacuum ($\Phi = h\nu_0$).

quickRevision: Total nodes = n - 1 (Radial = n - l - 1, Angular = l).
3d_z² has 0 planar nodes and 2 conical nodal surfaces.
4s electrons are lost before 3d during transition metal cation formation.
Orbital angular momentum L = √(l(l+1)) ℏ is independent of n.
